attribution: Municipal Demarcation Board (MDB), 2026 boundary datasets. Independently packaged for Civic Intelligence; original geometry retained. See source metadata and MDB reuse conditions.
transformation: ArcGIS WGS84 export, split by municipality. Full source attributes and unique coordinate pairs retained. One documented ST_MakeValid ring repair for Ward 52308005; original feature retained separately. No simplification.

laterElectionStatement.summary: Kopanong split stayed until the 2031 election cycle; one Kopanong municipality with nine wards for 2026.

legalReconciliation.observedLaterPublisherRevision: The September 2026 service removes five FS164 wards and adds FS162 Kopanong wards 8 and 9 compared with the May snapshot, reducing the national count by three to 4,485. The latest 213 local/metro and 52 district/metro codes join exactly to the existing 257-municipality catalogue.

limitations: Published geographic boundaries do not constitute a cadastral survey or legal boundary certificate.
The latest MDB local item description says 206 local municipalities, but actual data has 205 Category B and 8 Category A; validated record counts are used.
Ward numbers may be non-contiguous; Merafong has 25 ward features with numbers 1–28 excluding 8, 19 and 27. Do not invent missing polygons.
District standalone licenseInfo is empty; the local/ward item policy expressly covers municipal and ward boundary data generally.

local.transformation: ArcGIS REST outSR=4326, original unsimplified geometry; concatenated paginated results with all source attributes; no smoothing/snap/buffering.
